name: The Shattered Banquet
prompt: Scatter polygonal upright mirrors around a single narrow supper table. Each panel reflects only one course or one guest, composing a second impossible banquet across the yard. Copper serving dishes anchor the real table.

name: The Silver Reedbed
prompt: Plant an irregular thicket of very thin polished metal strips in dark gravel. Children part them with pale hoops to make fleeting passages. Small patches of reflected saffron coats ripple across the field as people walk.

name: The Well That Looks Up
prompt: Sink nested rings of sloped mirrors into a dry circular well, interrupted by one winding stair. A blue paper kite held above the mouth appears repeatedly deep inside. People at descending landings try to touch its reflection.

name: The Reversible Street
prompt: Arrange double-sided mirror shopfronts along a sharply bent alley. Market keepers hinge alternate panels outward to make a continuous reflected street across the bend. One bright melon stall appears in three otherwise empty doorways.

name: The Polished Laundry
prompt: Hang broad sheets of softly crumpled reflective foil between two black timber frames. Visitors use wooden rollers to smooth one small patch at a time, briefly restoring a face among shattered reflections. Used foil hangs rolled at the ends.
